summary: Member backup dispatch converges: needs-attention member runs are re-observed, never-started runs settle failed, verification stats points, rehome stays on the Store goroutine, and destination/hostname validation is tightened. API impact: changed contract.

guide.reason: Operators now see member runs settle after a member reconciles, never-started runs settle failed, a clearer member access message and stricter destination validation.

api.reason: BackupRepository validation refuses control characters, host:port names, dot prefixes, out-of-range S3 ports, oversized fields, malformed remote fingerprints and an NFS credential_ref; a pool join must report a valid hostname. Peer routes and payloads are unchanged; the master treats a member 404 as definite absence.

roadmap.reason: Fixes review findings in the current destination acceptance slice.

state.reason: No new durable record. The master's pool run records and Core journals already hold the state; retry spacing is in-memory and rebuilt after restart.

verification.method: Focused Go regressions in internal/agent and internal/protocol, each shown failing with its fix reverted through go test -overlay and passing after; the new agent tests also passed with -race. Broader focused agent, controller and localcore runs passed.
verification.limits: No lab, two-Core or forge CI run. Restores inherited by an emergency promotion without a local journal are not re-observed. The member-side journal/run crash window (run failed, journal needs_attention) needs the member reconciler fix in backup.go.
